scope: Groq HTTP transcription microbenchmark; no Telnyx carrier or OpenRouter inference tested

method.timing: HTTP request start through complete response; excludes audio acquisition and app coaching
method.audio: macOS Samantha synthetic speech, versions cut at 2/5/10 seconds, complete 8 kHz resample; public whisper.cpp JFK sample
limitations: Synthetic single voice and famous public speech do not establish noisy call accuracy
No live microphone, PSTN codec, two-speaker overlap, regional or load test
Three repeats per case are insufficient for reliable tail latency
Estimated charges use published list rates and minimum duration, not account billing readback
